diagnosis.root_cause: A fleet rollout of order-router repurposed the ROUTE_MODE flag, causing hosts h7 and h8 on the previous build to interpret the flag as the legacy routing path and trigger duplicate order submissions.
evidence: A rollout of order-router started a few minutes before
2026-10-28T14:30:00Z  order-router  9a8b7c6  repurpose flag ROUTE_MODE; fleet rollout in progress
2026-10-28T14:32:00Z  order-router  WARN  hosts h7,h8 on previous build: ROUTE_MODE flag interpreted as the legacy routing path
2026-10-28T14:34:00Z  order-router  ERROR  duplicate order submissions detected from the legacy routing path (h7,h8): 220 affected orders
diagnosis.recommended_fix: Pause or complete the rollout of order-router to ensure all hosts are running the current build and consistently interpreting the ROUTE_MODE flag, and investigate the affected orders for remediation.
